propositions: Local git call sites across rebar's store are unbounded under high concurrent use, with contention on git lock files (.git/index.lock, HEAD.lock, packed-refs.lock) surfacing as errors to agents instead of being absorbed
Rebar must handle local git lock contention automatically with no escalation to the agent: per-store advisory lock plus bounded jittered retry/backoff at the store git execution seam
Transient lock conflicts should resolve silently (debug/warning log only); only genuinely stuck locks (bounded budget exhausted) surface one actionable error naming the lock file with holder guidance
Watchdog timeouts (120s for plumbing, 300s for metrics) must bound local git call sites to prevent unbounded stalls while holding the store write lock from stalling every agent
Store write-lock contention sleeps must be jittered (uniform 0.75-1.25x multiplier) to de-synchronize concurrent processes and prevent thundering herd under high agent count
